name: Tavernbard
shortDescription: AI game master for Discord. Homepage describes a free path that uses your own AI subscription.
longDescription: Tavernbard is an AI game master aimed at Discord. You can play using your own AI subscription. See their site for current pricing.
bestFor: Groups that already pay for a model subscription
notIdealFor: In-engine NPCs inside Unity or Unreal
strength: The homepage describes an AI game master for Discord, including a play path that uses an AI subscription you already have.
weakness: That play path still depends on an AI subscription you already have, and a $49.99 homepage figure is not described as a monthly plan.

useCaseFit.game-npcs: AI game master for Discord that can use an AI subscription you already have.
